endorsements.name: Christian Grothoff
endorsements.label: GNUNet
endorsements.description: GNUNet is an anonymous peer-to-peer networking infrastructure. GNUnet provides anonymity, confidentiality, deniability and accountability, goals that were thought to be mutually exclusive. In GNUnet, users can search for files without revealing the query to anybody. Intermediaries can not decrypt the query or the reply, but they can verify that the reply is a valid answer for the query. This allows GNUnet to deploy a trust-based accounting scheme that does not require end-to-end knowledge about transactions and that is used to limit the impact of flooding attacks.
